events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw three touchdown passes and the Patriots held off the 27-25 when Nick Folk's 58-yard field goal attempt was blocked on the last play Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots block last-second kick, hold off Jets

headlines.description: Kyle Orton hit Sammy Watkins on a 2-yard touchdown for the winning score with 1 second remaining as the Buffalo Bills beat the Minnesota Vikings 17-16 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watkins last-second TD lifts Bills over Vikings

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw for 277 yards and two touchdowns in an efficient performance, and the Miami Dolphins beat the Chicago Bears 27-14 on Sunday.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw two touchdown passes in the final 3:38, including the winner to Corey Fuller with 1:48 remaining, and the Detroit Lions rallied for a 24-23 victory over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Two late TDs get Stafford, Lions past Saints

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for 255 yards and three touchdowns, Randall Cobb torched the Carolina secondary for 121 yards receiving and the Green Bay Packers routed the Carolina Panthers 38-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers rout Carolina, Rodgers has 3 TDs

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes and the Colts' defense dominated Cincinnati in Sunday's 27-0 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts blank Bengals, win 5th straight

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Punter Johnny Hekker's pass from the St. Louis 18 caught the Seattle Seahawks by surprise for the last of three big plays by Rams special teams in a 28-26 victory over the defending Super Bowl champions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trick play, TD return help Rams stun Seattle

headlines.description: Kai Forbath kicked a 22-yard field goal on the last play of the game, and Colt McCoy stepped in after Kirk Cousins was benched at halftime Sunday to lead the Washington Redskins to a 19-17 win over the Tennessee Titans.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy steps in at QB, leads Redskins to win

headlines.description: Jaguars snap 9-game losing streak against Browns
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson (127 yards) carries Jags to 1st win

headlines.description: Elvis Dumervil and Pernell McPhee each had two sacks, part of a dominant defensive performance that carried the Baltimore Ravens past the Atlanta Falcons 29-7 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens get defensive in 29-7 win over Falcons

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Cairo Santos kicked a 48-yard field goal field goal with 21 seconds left and the Kansas City Chiefs beat San Diego 23-20 Sunday, snapping the Chargers' five-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs snap Chargers' streak with late FG

events.name: New York Giants at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw three touchdown passes, DeMarco Murray broke Jim Brown's 56-year-old NFL record with his seventh straight 100-yard rushing game to start a season, and the Cowboys won their sixth straight by beating the Giants 31-21.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys dump Giants to extend streak to 6

headlines.description: Peyton Manning's receivers played keep-away with his milestone memento and the NFL's new leader in career touchdown passes toyed with the San Francisco 49ers in the Denver Broncos' emphatic 42-17 victory Sunday night.

Ben Roethlisberger passed for two touchdowns and wide receiver Antonio Brown added another on a gadget play during a dizzying stretch late in the first half, helping the Steelers rally for a 30-23 win over the mistake-prone Texans on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers rally to overwhelm sloppy Texans
